title: Layout rhythm

domain.defaultBehavior: normal (factor 1) — byte-identical to the pre-rhythm cascade in every vertical, because the DS floor already resolves --ds-rhythm-effective-scale to 1

compatibility: additive, unset-to-rollback. ORTHOGONAL to density.mode by construction and never a second spelling of it: density scales control SIZES through --ds-density-effective-scale, rhythm scales the LAYOUT RELATIONSHIPS between controls (gap, layout padding) through --ds-rhythm-effective-scale. A chain carrying both factors is correct rather than double-scaled — the control keeps its density size while the room around it breathes. Rhythm is applied at the PRESET rungs, never at a consume site, so a consumer numeric gap stays exact geometry exactly as it does under density; and it never reaches a control height, touch target or icon box, which is what keeps the coarse-pointer touch floors intact by construction rather than by clamping. The 0.8-1.25 envelope is enforced in the derived channel, so it binds the compiler artifact, the BrandTheme lowering and a raw tokenOverride alike.

knownDefects.finding: Eight current block-size fallbacks multiply 415px by rhythm and therefore change panel capacity instead of spacing.

openContractQuestions: Prove static and DB invalid-input behavior, not merely equal valid enum output.
Generalize the existing density five-plane harness instead of creating a second authority harness.
Add a fail-closed census that rejects every block-size, height, touch-target and icon-size read of the effective rhythm channel.
